text:
maya: short thread \- thinking about explicit interface boundaries: a fast ingest check (30s) vs async deep bench. want clear PASS/WARN/FAIL semantics before RFC. open to quick takes?
jordan: fast-check should be tiny: model load, a couple golden prompts, kv-cache smoke, basic mem check.
kevin: agree. fast-check must emit a compact summary JSON with status, fingerprint, and quick_metrics so deep-bench can reuse results.
sasha: add runtime invariants: allocator health, dtype casts, attention mask shapes. fast-check must detect fatal incompatibilities.
maya: propose enums: PASS/WARN/FAIL. WARN -> one auto-retry + quick triage. FAIL -> block staging. deep-bench async with full evals.
devon: variants: fast-check validates canonical artifact only; deep-bench accepts a variants list (fp32, int8, etc.) and runs in parallel.
jordan: include infra metadata (cuda/cudnn/kernel versions) in both payloads for triage.
kevin: infra run locations: fast-check on intake worker (onboard-fast), timeout 45s; deep-bench as k8s job on bench pool. put configs in model descriptor.
maya: descriptor example (yaml string in model entry) and a skip_deep_bench_if predicate (tiny models or low variance).
sasha: telemetry keys: fast_check.{load_ms,peak_mem_mb,quick_score}; deep_bench.{eval_suite_ids,histograms,perf_curve_url}. stable keys drive UI/alerts.
devon: golden prompts: two-tier approach: canonical infra set + team-owned quality sets. deep-bench runs both.
kevin: rollback: if deep-bench finds regression post-fast-pass, soft-fallback traffic to previous variant, mark quarantined, open ticket.
ops-bot: bench-runner will call /incidents/create with {model, bench_url, summary}. webhook PR exists.
maya: actions: (1) i'll draft RFC for descriptor + semantics, (2) kevin/jordan define retry/failure budgets, (3) sasha/devon define telemetry & golden ownership, (4) kevin wire ops-bot flow. aim: draft in 7 days.
jordan: suggest adding a tiny conformance harness (python) fast-check runs to normalize outputs across runtimes.
maya: thanks all, i'll post RFC tomorrow and link it here. :thumbsup:
